reason: Fails A: the description says cache entries never expire and need no TTL, and it names `_key()` as the helper, all of which the final diff contradicts (it adds `--cache-ttl`/`ttl=` and renames the helper to `cache_key`). It also says the cache lives under `~/.cache/logslice/` without mentioning the `LOGSLICE_CACHE_DIR` or XDG resolution, so it fails B and C as well.
